name: She-Hulk (Deathless)

abilityDetails.Trauma: Alınan vuruşlar, yakın zamanda verilen hasarın bir kısmını ek fiziksel hasar patlaması olarak verdirir.
abilityDetails.Fear: Unblockable yetenek doğruluğunu sabit %100 azaltır ve Mükemmel Blok Şansını kaldırır.
abilityDetails.Wither: Rakibin güç kazanma ve iyileşme etkilerini zayıflatır.
abilityDetails.Debilitate: Debilitate dışında yeni uygulanan debuff'ların süresini uzatır.
abilityDetails.Weakness: Saldırı gücünü düşürür; sıfırın altına inemez.
abilityDetails.Special Concussion: Etkilenen şampiyonların özel saldırı sırasındaki yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.

signatureAbility:
Stare Decisis
She-Hulk eats punks like you for breakfast. Her long career of stomping noobs grants her a benefit based on the Opponent's class.
Science: When the Opponent activates a Special Attack, inflict an indefinite [5 - 15]% Special Concussion Debuff. Max stacks: 4.
Mutant: During the Opponent's Special Attacks, She-Hulk gains a +[181.46- 4,125] Bulwark Passive.
Mystic: While the Opponent is below a Bar of Power, personal Fear and Trauma Debuffs expire [15 - 50]% more slowly.
Cosmic: She-Hulk's personal Debuffs gain [3 - 10]% increased duration per Unique Buff on the Opponent. Max benefit at 5 Buffs.
Tech: While below a Bar of Power, She-Hulk gains +[5 - 15]% Combat Power Rate.
immunityDetails:
• Zehir Bağışıklığı 🧪
• Yırtılma Bağışıklığı (ile sinerji: Thanos Deathless) ☣️

abilitySections.title: Aggressive Negotiations - Always Active
content: An enhanced immune system provides full Immunity to Poison.
When striking the Opponent or when struck, She-Hulk has a 40% chance to inflict a 14% Trauma Debuff for 12 seconds.
For each Trauma on the Opponent, the chance to inflict is reduced by 2% flat, to a minimum of 10%, and the potency is increased by 1%.
She-Hulk doesn't share. Her Trauma Debuffs are paused during her Strikers.

abilitySections.title: Inspire Fear
content: She-Hulk's voracious appetite for destruction terrifies her victims, increasing their chance to launch a Special Attack by 8% for each of her personal Trauma Debuffs on the Opponent.
When a non-Skill Opponent activates a Special Attack, She-Hulk refreshes all personal Trauma Debuffs on them.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: If the Opponent is Unblockable, She-Hulk's Heavy Attack can not be interrupted by Basic Attacks or the final hit of Special Attacks. If the attack lands, all Unblockable effects are removed and She-Hulk inflicts 2 personal Trauma Debuffs.
Each hit against a non-Skill Opponent inflicts a non-stacking Fear Debuff for 12 seconds.
While her personal Fear is active, She-Hulk cannot Miss.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, inflict a personal Trauma Debuff.
Each hit inflicts a 15% Spectre Debuff for 12 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, inflict 2 personal Trauma Debuffs.
Each hit inflicts a 55% Wither Debuff for 22 seconds. Max stacks: 2.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict an indefinite 20% Debilitate Debuff. Max stacks: 2.
Reinflict all personal Trauma Debuffs on the Opponent.
Inflict a 30% Weakness Debuff for 12 seconds.
